entities.name: Józef Hauke-Bosak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Józef Hauke-Bosak was a Polish military leader of the January Uprising. A close ally of rebel leader Romuald Traugutt, Hauke-Bosak commanded the Polish Army in Lesser Poland, where he fought many successful battles against the Russians. He left Poland after the uprising collapsed in 1864. Hauke-Bosak was killed in battle while serving in the French Army during the Franco-Prussian War.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Józef Hauke-Bosak was a Polish military leader of the January Uprising. A close ally of rebel leader Romuald Traugutt, Hauke-Bosak commanded the Polish Army in Lesser Poland, where he fought many successful battles against the Russians. He left Poland after the uprising collapsed in 1864. Hauke-Bosak was killed in battle while serving in the French Army during the Franco-Prussian War.
